VERDICT: CHALLENGE DeepSeek F004 | The claim that `get_parameter()` will raise `KeyError` when a schema default is missing is unsupported by the code. It raises `KeyError` only when `dotpath` is absent from `self._schema`; if a schema entry has `default = None`, `get_parameter()` returns `None`, not `KeyError`.
